system.description: Your study of aeromancy has given you the power to create minor magical effects that interact with the element of air: you can conjure small gusts of wind, cycle toxic air out of an enclosed space, whip up a tiny cyclone on a flat surface, or carry your voice on the breeze to speak at normal volume to a creature one hundred feet away. When you test your abilities with such a feat, the Judge may call for an AGILITY | MAGIC check to determine the efficacy.
